patch_description:
This version keeps the input-derived scaffold requirement, but increases search diversity and adds stronger ruin/refill moves.

It builds multiple C4-free subsets of the supplied input edges using degree-based and randomized source orders. Each scaffold is saturated using a legal insertion rule based on the no-common-neighbor characterization. Saturation scores insertions by estimated future candidate loss, degree balance, and source-edge preference.

Compared with the previous version, the archive is larger and local search includes targeted one-edge, medium, and larger obstruction-aware deletion phases. Larger removals can escape locally maximal C4-free configurations that cannot be improved by only removing two or three edges. All inserted states are explicitly validated, and final repair is deletion-only if needed.
